acceptance.criterion_verbatim: Each of the 8 is RE-CARDED at v3.1 BY ITS OWNING LANE as an ordinary card. STOP: NO v1->v3.1 MIGRATOR. A migrator would manufacture key_expression, basis and provenance values that v1 never asked its author for -- a value with no measurement behind it, carrying the authority of a schema-conformant field. The whole point of the qualification is that a human named the key expression; a tool inventing one defeats it.
